PlayClipStep.description:
Play an animation clip baked into the model (e.g. an engine cycle). The clip keeps
running through the following steps until the animation ends or another clip starts, so
later steps can explain what is moving. Clip names are checked by the viewer, which skips
a clip the model does not have.
PlayClipStep.title: PlayClipStep

ProceduralSource.description:
A trusted, prebuilt procedural generator in the renderer (design §7.1-A).

`generator` must exist in the renderer's allowlisted registry; params are flat scalars only.
ProceduralSource.title: ProceduralSource

PromptDraftRequest.description: Topic for an AI-written, in-depth 3D build brief (3D library).

QuizSettings.description: Delivery settings, frozen into each published version.

SpeechIn.description: Text to read aloud: one tour step (part name, explanation, link to the topic).

SpeechStatus.description: Whether voice narration is available on this server (an ElevenLabs key is configured).
SpeechStatus.title: SpeechStatus

StudentAssessment.description: No answer keys, rubrics or explanations before submission.
StudentAssessment.title: StudentAssessment

StudioSceneOut.description: A published 3D scene a student can open in the Studio (from their enrolled courses).
StudioSceneOut.title: StudioSceneOut

UserSummary.title: UserSummary
